name: Home
description: Home Assistant switches, buttons and displays you hang on your walls. Pick the kind, hang it, then choose the device.

variants.name: Switch
variants.description: A wall rocker for a light, plug or fan. Tap to toggle; the dot glows in the light's color.

variants.name: Button
variants.description: A push button for a scene, script or button. Tap to run it.

variants.name: Display
variants.description: A small screen showing a sensor, thermostat or player.
